# Ready2Play — maintainer's Steam guide

- Original source: [Ready2Play — maintainer's Steam guide](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3290654040)
- Author / publication: LuKeSt0rm / Steam Community
- Language / date: English; published 2024-07-16; updated 2024-10-11
- Access: Full guide page retrieved directly
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: [Wayback Machine, 2025-09-04](http://web.archive.org/web/20250904075814/https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3290654040)
- Format: header notes, original summary, then the complete guide data

The maintainer describes a launcher for retail, GOG, and Steam copies, supplied without the complete game data.

Advertised features include OpenGL, Direct3D 9, and Direct3D 12 through 9on12; windowed and borderless display; aspect-ratio options; higher resolutions with UI adjustments; language selection; an optional classic Steam font; and fixes for Alt+Tab. It also advertises intro control and developer debug commands.

The guide links to the [ModDB download page](https://www.moddb.com/mods/robin-hood-legend-of-sherwood-ready2play-launcher/downloads/robin-hood-legend-of-sherwood-ready2play-launcher).

**Limitations:** these are the maintainer's compatibility claims, not tests performed here. The launcher changes the runtime environment, so reports using it should be distinguished from observations of the unmodified executable.

## Complete guide data

Guide metadata at retrieval: posted 16 Jul 2024 10:22am, updated 11 Oct 2024 2:01am; category Modding or Configuration; 1,340 unique visitors, 17 favourites; no comments. Single section "Ready2Play Launcher" with the tagline that the launcher is supplied without the complete game files.

Feature list as printed (14 items): improved compatibility and performance; supports any retail, GOG or Steam version; OpenGL, Direct3D 9 and Direct3D 12 (9on12) renderers; windowed and borderless windowed-fullscreen modes; aspect-ratio support (enable/disable); portable custom launcher with easy configuration; add game languages and switch via launcher; Steam classic font (enable/disable); higher resolutions with texts adjusted in the graphics options; UI fix for the new higher resolutions; Alt+Tab issues fixed; no registry values; developer debug commands enabled; intro enable/disable.

Instructions: extract to any location and start the launcher; after the first start the game can be launched normally without it. Download link: ModDB (`robin-hood-legend-of-sherwood-ready2play-launcher`). One screenshot of the launcher window.
